Option A: Less, because the tension in the string varies directly with the wave speed, which varies inversely with the wavelength.
Option B: Greater, because the tension in the string varies directly with the wave speed, which varies inversely with the wavelength.
Option C: Greater, because the tension in the string varies directly with the wave speed, which varies directly with the wavelength.
Option D: Less, because the tension in the string varies directly with the wave speed, which varies directly with t
